titel: Kelly Reilly Unpacks Her Iconic Character Beth Dutton

einzeiler: Kelly Reilly unpacks her iconic role as Beth Dutton and her passion for gardening.
kurzfassung: Kelly Reilly sits down with Martha Stewart to discuss playing the fierce character Beth Dutton on Yellowstone and Dutton Ranch. She shares how she developed her Montana accent, her love for horses and country life, and her plans for a much-needed break. The two also bond over their shared appreciation for old houses, nature, and the hard work of ranching.
stichpunkte: Kelly Reilly has been playing Beth Dutton since 2017 and admits the character initially terrified her.
She works diligently with a dialect coach to perfect her American and Montana accents.
A scene in Dutton Ranch where a character snaps over the wrong knife was directly inspired by Martha Stewart's own documentary.
Reilly initially thought Beth was completely unlike her, but over time she has found parts of herself in the character.
She grew up riding horses in England and worked at stables during her teenage years.
Reilly prefers a quiet, country lifestyle over city living and owns a 320-year-old cottage in West Sussex.
She plans to take six months off to spend time in her garden, read, and enjoy being at home before filming the next season in January.

beschreibung:
Kelly Reilly is an actress best known for her fierce and complicated character, Beth Dutton, on the hit TV series Yellowstone and the spin-off Dutton Ranch. Kelly has been playing Beth for nearly 10 years, and she joins Martha today to discuss the behind-the-scenes of getting into her character's psychology, what she finds interesting in a character, and what she does in her time off. They also discuss Kelly’s background in theater, turning books into movies, and how she can’t wait to get into her English countryside garden.
